widgets_values: An Eastern female singer softly sang into a vintage microphone, her head moving slowly and delicately, her hair gently swaying with the wind, and her breathing was natural and soft. The camera held slightly and moved in a small, slow and restrained manner. In the background, the guitarist played the guitar slowly and leisurely. The composition, color, lighting and character design were all fully retained, creating a cinematic portrait with a rich jazz atmosphere. The picture was smooth and natural, high-definition and detailed, presenting a texture similar to a real live recording.
